name: id
doc: Unicode code point of the character. A later QuadChar or Char with the same id replaces this one

name: rect_x
doc: Left edge of the glyph in the Texture, in pixels

name: rect_y
doc: Top edge of the glyph in the Texture, in pixels

name: rect_w
doc: Width of the glyph in the Texture, in pixels

name: rect_h
doc: Height of the glyph in the Texture, in pixels

name: offset_x
doc: Horizontal draw offset of the glyph

name: offset_y
doc: Vertical draw offset of the glyph. The font keeps the largest -offset_y across all glyphs

name: width
doc: Horizontal advance after the glyph, before CharSpace is added
